messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane gateways reporting elevated 5xx (502/504) and backend timeout spikes across auth, org-lookup, and billing. Alert threshold breached (5m). Attachments: grafana://dash/control-plane-5xx

alisha: seeing it on latency dash too, p50->p95 widened. 502s clustered around gateway-proxy -> auth service.

ben: confirmed. logs show repeated `upstream timed out` from auth and occasional `cache-miss` from org-lookup. Sample: ```ERROR gateway: upstream request to auth timed out after 20s \n auth-service: POST /v1/validate -> 504 (upstream timeout)```

tarun: rolling through infra, looks like redis TTLs spiked and our org-lookup cache miss ratio jumped to ~72% for the last 8m. Billing write latency also up, so writes to billing-service are stalling.

lena: support: 12 customers flagged, 3 high-tier experiencing request aborts in-app (timeouts). Customer-impact link: https://tickets/INC-9921

alisha: quick mitigation ideas — can we: 1) scale auth replicas, 2) fallback org-lookup to local mapping for known orgs, 3) temporarily enqueue billing writes instead of sync write? opinions?

ben: +1 to enqueue billing writes, put in a background worker. I can flip a feature-flag for sync->async within 5m.

marta: docs note — please capture the failover steps so we can include in postmortem.

tarun: scaling auth now: ```kubectl -n platform scale deploy/auth-service --replicas=6``` doing healthcheck wave. also increasing redis replica count and read replicas.

alisha: oncall -> ben (taking ownership). tagging @ben. I’ll coordinate customer comms. ops-rotation: handing off to ben for next 30m.

ops-rotation: handoff acknowledged. paging cadence set to 5m.

ben: feature-flag flipped to async-billing-write (ff-billing-async=true). Observability: queued depth increased but no errors on enqueue.

ben: enabling local org mapping fallback for top 50 orgs via config toggle: ```POST /admin/feature-toggle {"orglookup_local_fallback": true}``` confirmed rollout to gateways.

alisha: can someone patch gateway retry strategy? Current retries are aggressive and flooding auth. Suggest reduce to 1 retry with exponential backoff.

tarun: pushed retry change to proxies: ```gateway.config.retries.default = 1``` rolling restart.

ben: auth replica scale healthy, p95 latency down from 9s -> 1.8s in ~4m. 5xx rate trending down.

lena: support: updating the incident page, notifying top impacted customers with temporary workaround (retries/backoff).

alisha: quick ask — was there a deploy before spike? anyone see config deploy ~3357999800?

ben: yes, last config-rollout at 3357999752, it toggled heartbeat persistence to low TTL which probably caused cache churn. suspect rollout amplified load on org-lookup/redis leading to upstream timeouts.

tarun: looking at redis metrics — connections and eviction rate spiked right after the config rollout. Rolling back config to previous commit now. ```git revert --no-edit 7a3f1c9```. Deploying rollback.

sre-bot: Deploy event: rollback of gateway-config (commit 7a3f1c9) triggered by tarun at 3358000440. CI passed.

ben: rollback applied, observing org-lookup cache warmup. 5xx count falling fast. p99 still a bit noisy.

marta: logging note: capture timeline and toggles for postmortem (who flipped billing ff, who toggled fallback).

alisha: customer-impact: reduced to 2 customers in error window, both alerted. Lena drafting advisory.

ben: running followup commands to flush bad cache items: ```curl -X POST https://admin/redis/flush?pattern=org:*:temp``` done.

tarun: redis eviction rates normalizing. auth 5xx at baseline. Gateway 502s down to <0.2% from peak 6%.

ops-rotation: handing off monitoring to alisha for the next hour. ben stay on standby.

lena: raising P0 support ticket for the two affected accounts, assigning account success leads.

alisha: summary: root cause = config rollout that lowered heartbeat/persistence TTLs -> org-lookup cache churn -> added load to auth and billing -> upstream timeouts causing 5xx. Mitigations: rollback, scale auth, enable local fallback, async billing writes, reduce gateway retries.

ben: will follow up with PR to add an automated canary for config TTL changes and a guardrail preventing TTL < X. also add a rate-limiter on gateway retries.

marta: will draft postmortem template. tagging you all. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: Incident: mitigated at 3358000700. Final metrics snapshot: peak 5xx rate 5.8% (5m), customer impacted: 12 flagged, 2 still affected at mitigation time, no data loss reported.

alisha: closing the incident thread, creating postmortem ticket INC-9921-PM. Thanks team. :tada:
